summary.intent: Complete phase 49 wave 2/3 of an SDK rebuild, then start wave 3/3 focused on batch/drag move parity features.
summary.outcome: Plan 49-03 was verified clean (5 commits, web tsc -b passed), wave 2/3 marked complete, and wave 3/3 was initiated by dispatching plan 49-04 via a subagent.

repo: The web package does not have a 'typecheck' script in package.json; the correct typecheck command is 'tsc -b' run directly.
workflow: Post-wave gate pattern: spot-check recent commits + run tsc -b before proceeding to the next wave to confirm integration.
vitest-generic issues can be auto-fixed as a minor side effect during plan execution without blocking progress.
Wave/plan dispatch uses the Agent tool to parallelize or serialize subagent execution within a larger phased rollout.

friction: The web package lacked a 'typecheck' npm script, requiring a fallback to 'tsc -b' directly — caused an extra lookup step.
open_items: Plan 49-04 (REQ-6: batch + drag move parity — multi-select, SelectionActionBar, batch loop, items prop, SharedFolderRow drag-drop) was dispatched but not yet completed.
